text.title: Design Docs Patterns Decision Tree
text.summary: Run-or-skip gate based on preconditions, then a second-level question routing to a rule-id conclusion: format selection by scope, or pause on missing inputs. Minimum-form tree for a methodology of this shape.

decision-tree.root-question: Do the Applies-If preconditions hold AND none of the Skip-If disqualifiers fire?

branch.question: Are the Prerequisites artefacts present AND cited with evidence, and what is the scope classification?

branch.conclusion: Run the methodology with a heavyweight format (Amazon 6-Pager or Uber RFC); produce the artefact per output contract.

branch.when: inputs_complete == true and scope in {small, team}
branch.conclusion: Run the methodology with the lightweight Google-style format — produce the artefact per output contract.
Pause; gather missing Prerequisites with cited evidence before run.
Skip this methodology. Name the failing Applies-If condition or the firing Skip-If disqualifier.

text.example: preconditions=true inputs_complete=true scope=team → run per r1-one-day-trigger with lightweight format; artefact passes validate-design-docs-patterns.py exit 0.
